# Probabilistic Seismic Hazard Assessment (PSHA)

## Executive Summary {#sec-hazard_summary}

{{< include /_chapters/hazard.summary.md >}}

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
for (i in seq_len(nrow(SiteTable))) {
  .knitReportBlock(
    path = "/_summary/hazard.results.qmd",
    stem = "hazard-summary",
    sites = SiteTable,
    i = i,
    vars = list(
      ID.target = ID.gmdp,
      p.target = "mean",
      Tn.target = Tn.PGA
    ),
    root = root,
    heading = SiteTable$label[[i]],
    level = 3L,
    anchor = "sec-hazard-summary-site",
    context = "hazard summary"
  )
}
rm(i)
```
